refiner_head_warmup_schedule.optimizer_parameter_policy: optimizer is constructed once from every originally trainable parameter before requires_grad staging

parameter_stage_schedule.optimizer_parameter_policy: one optimizer contains all originally trainable tensors; requires_grad selects each stage and the global cosine schedule makes the final joint stage low learning rate

effective_runtime.validation_rng_policy: global inference RNG is reset before every validation pass; validation DataLoader generator is reset to inference_seed + 17

subset_definitions.bim_foreground_conflict: GT is closer than BIM by max(0.10m, 5% of BIM depth)
subset_definitions.bim_no_hit: valid GT with no fixed-envelope BIM ray hit

method_definitions.raw_da3: cached frozen DA3 output; no BIM
method_definitions.legacy_global_scale_q45: historical q=.45 BIM scale applied to cached DA3
method_definitions.legacy_bim_direct_q45: historical q=.45 scale plus registered local correction
method_definitions.robust_global_scale: frozen train-selected robust log-cap BIM scale applied to cached DA3
method_definitions.robust_bim_direct: robust global scale plus the unchanged registered local correction
method_definitions.bim_envelope: raw fixed-envelope render; standalone hit-support metrics and coverage only
method_definitions.coarse: model metric-scale input before learned local refinement; exact alias of live_scale for E2E checkpoints
method_definitions.proportional_refined: scale output after multiplicative low/detail log residual but before the pixel-level additive metric residual, with the same model-output safety bound as the final prediction

comparison_support_policy.rule: Every comparable method uses the exact declared GT subset; any non-finite or non-positive prediction on support is a fatal error

standalone_bim_envelope.support_definition: gt_valid & bim_valid; excluded from fixed-support method comparisons
